parts.text: "OpenCode, output a JSON object with exactly three keys check_approval, check_static, check_ai_use_log. Each value is a short two-sentence technical English module docstring WITHOUT Python triple quotes. No tool calls. Actual behaviors: Gate 1 retains the original AT-01–AT-08 and revision records, requires fresh scoped approvals for changed execution files in the current Git comparison, checks the written test/evidence files and compares the approval time with the first matching implementation commit. Gate 2 runs lint, types, declared dependency consistency and permissions; changes to safety modules require a scoped accepted ADR and API compatibility comparison with the Git base. Gate 6 matches changed code and runtime prompt paths to new or amended AI-use log entries relative to Git; verifies evidence and review files, plus original prompt and session ID for OpenCode. No fabricated claims or missing actions. Return JSON only."

{"check_approval": "Gate 1 retains original AT-01 through AT-08 and revision records, requiring fresh scoped approvals for changed execution files in the current Git comparison. It checks written test and evidence files and compares approval time against the first matching implementation commit.", "check_static": "Gate 2 runs lint, type checks, declared dependency consistency, and permission validation. Changes to safety modules require a scoped accepted ADR plus an API compatibility comparison against the Git base.", "check_ai_use_log": "Gate 6 matches changed code and runtime prompt paths to new or amended AI-use log entries relative to Git. It verifies evidence and review files plus the original prompt and session ID for OpenCode."}
